intent: Replace only explicit-edge unweighted blocked-sector histogram counting; preserve every health output for the same inputs, state and latency argument.

candidate_scope.strategy: searchsorted(side=right), exact rightmost-edge adjustment using array comparison, and integer bincount; preserve original azimuth and edges.
candidate_scope.supported_values: One-dimensional native NumPy float32 or float64 arrays.
candidate_scope.supported_edges: One-dimensional native float32 or float64 arrays with 2 to 257 finite strictly increasing edges.
candidate_scope.fallback: Use the existing np.histogram(values,bins=edges)[0] for every unsupported dtype, shape, edge count, or edge ordering.
candidate_scope.timing: Do not change detector stage timers or the latency argument passed to HealthMonitor; timing_ms.total currently ends before health.update and is not full-call time.

correctness_acceptance: Exact integer count and dtype equality with np.histogram for all tested supported and fallback cases; no numerical tolerance.

Cover float32/float64 edge and value combinations, noninteger widths 0.3 and 7, exact edges and adjacent representable values, rightmost inclusion, signed zero, NaN/infinities, empty input and zero-bin layouts.
Cover strided/read-only input, values crossing the 65,536-point working block, very many edges, unsupported numeric dtypes, duplicate/descending/nonfinite edges, and relevant error behavior.
Preserve the previously rejected float32 endpoint case as an explicit regression.

Full HealthMonitor state-sequence dictionaries must equal the histogram oracle, including blocked-sectors severity, clear/monitored distance, calibration/latency warnings and both latency_affects_decision settings.
Configuration, native kernels, detection/tracking logic and latency-monitor definition remain unchanged.

authorized_now: Small isolated fixed-cloud microprobe may record exact counts and health outputs, with loaded-machine timing labelled exploratory.
deferred: Full regression/history gate until root coordinates CPU.
Quiet original positive and clear ROS acceptance with identical runtime/config/inputs before claiming latency or freshness improvement.
evaluation_plan.timing_interpretation: The concurrent P3 gate makes current timings unsuitable for performance acceptance; no speed claim from loaded timings.

prior_rejected_prototype.failure: Scalar endpoint comparison rounded a float64 endpoint against float32 values, shifting a count at 0.3-degree width; retain an array endpoint.
